```{python}
#| output: false
#| echo: false
import json
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

import sys, os

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "..")))
from src.backend.backend_functions import *

initialize_data()
player_color_map, archetype_color_map, decktype_color_map = get_color_maps()

INITIAL_PLAYERS = [
    "Dimlas", "Andrin", "Sili", "Manuel", "Lukas Stalder",
    "Tommy", "Noe", "Guy", "Ivo"
]

player_elo_df = get_player_elo()

# Latest elo entry per player/draft
player_elo_df = (
    player_elo_df
    .sort_values(["player", "draft_id"])
    .groupby(["player", "draft_id"], as_index=False)
    .last()
)

# Remove Bye and NA
player_elo_df = player_elo_df[
    player_elo_df["player"].notna()
    & (player_elo_df["player"] != "")
    & (player_elo_df["player"] != "Missing Player")
]

player_elo_df = player_elo_df.sort_values(["season_id", "draft_id"])
player_elo_df = add_season_draft_labels(player_elo_df)
```

#| echo: false
import html
from IPython.display import HTML, display

players = sorted(player_elo_df["player"].unique())
initial = [p for p in INITIAL_PLAYERS if p in players]

items = "".join(
    '<label class="pf-item" data-name="{low}">'
    '<input type="checkbox" class="pf-cb" value="{esc}"{chk}>'
    '<span class="pf-dot" style="display:inline-block;width:.7rem;height:.7rem;'
    'border-radius:50%;flex:none;background:{col}"></span>'
    '<span class="pf-name">{esc}</span></label>'.format(
        low=html.escape(p.lower()),
        esc=html.escape(p),
        chk=" checked" if p in initial else "",
        col=player_color_map.get(p, "#999999"),
    )
    for p in players
)

display(HTML(
    '<div id="pf">'
    '<input type="text" id="pf-search" placeholder="Search player">'
    '<div class="pf-btns">'
    '<button type="button" id="pf-all">All</button>'
    '<button type="button" id="pf-none">None</button>'
    '<button type="button" id="pf-reset">Reset</button>'
    '</div>'
    '<div id="pf-list">' + items + '</div>'
    '<script type="application/json" id="pf-initial">'
    + json.dumps(initial) +
    '</script>'
    '</div>'
))

```{=html}
<style>
#pf { font-size: .85rem; padding-right: .25rem; }

/* leave room for the sidebar collapse arrow on the first row */
#pf-search {
  width: calc(100% - 2.0rem);
  margin-bottom: .4rem;
  padding: .25rem .4rem;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
#pf-search:focus { outline-offset: -1px; }   /* focus ring was being clipped */

#pf .pf-btns { display: flex; gap: .25rem; margin-bottom: .5rem; }
#pf .pf-btns button { flex: 1; font-size: .75rem; padding: .2rem 0; cursor: pointer; }

#pf-list { max-height: 70vh; overflow-y: auto; padding-right: .35rem; }
#pf .pf-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .4rem; padding: .12rem 0; cursor: pointer; }
#pf .pf-item.pf-hidden { display: none; }
#pf .pf-name { white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
</style>
<script>
(function () {
  function ready() {
    const root = document.getElementById("pf");
    const el = document.querySelector(".js-plotly-plot");
    if (!root || !el || !el.data || !window.Plotly) return false;
    if (root.dataset.bound) return true;
    root.dataset.bound = "1";

    const INITIAL = new Set(
      JSON.parse(document.getElementById("pf-initial").textContent)
    );

    function apply() {
      const on = new Set(
        Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(".pf-cb:checked")).map(c => c.value)
      );
      Plotly.restyle(
        el,
        { visible: el.data.map(t => (on.has(t.name) ? true : "legendonly")) },
        el.data.map((_, i) => i)
      );
    }

    function setAll(fn) {
      root.querySelectorAll(".pf-cb").forEach(c => { c.checked = fn(c.value); });
      apply();
    }

    root.addEventListener("change", e => {
      if (e.target.classList.contains("pf-cb")) apply();
    });
    root.querySelector("#pf-all").onclick   = () => setAll(() => true);
    root.querySelector("#pf-none").onclick  = () => setAll(() => false);
        function resetZoom() {
      Plotly.relayout(el, { "xaxis.autorange": true, "yaxis.autorange": true });
    }

    root.querySelector("#pf-reset").onclick = () => {
      setAll(v => INITIAL.has(v));
      resetZoom();
      fit();
    };

    root.querySelector("#pf-search").addEventListener("input", e => {
      const q = e.target.value.toLowerCase();
      root.querySelectorAll(".pf-item").forEach(it => {
        it.classList.toggle("pf-hidden", q && !it.dataset.name.includes(q));
      });
    });

       
    function fit() { Plotly.Plots.resize(el); }
    window.addEventListener("resize", fit);
    fit();

    apply();
    return true;
  }

  const t = setInterval(() => { if (ready()) clearInterval(t); }, 150);
  setTimeout(() => clearInterval(t), 20000);
})();
</script>
```


## Column

```{python}

fig = px.line(
    player_elo_df,
    x="season_draft_label",
    y="elo",
    color="player",
    color_discrete_map=player_color_map,
    labels={"elo": "ELO Rating", "season_draft_label": "Draft", "player": "Player"},
    line_shape="spline",
    category_orders={
        "season_draft_label": list(player_elo_df["season_draft_label"].unique())
    },
)

for trace in fig.data:
    trace.visible = True if trace.name in INITIAL_PLAYERS else "legendonly"

_ = fig.add_hline(
    y=1000,
    line_dash="dot",
    line_color="red",
    line_width=3,
    annotation_text="ELO = 1000",
    annotation_position="top right",
    annotation_xshift=-25,
)

for y in (1200, 1100, 900, 800):
    _ = fig.add_hline(
        y=y,
        line_dash="dot",
        line_color="rgba(0,0,0,0.2)",
        line_width=2,
        annotation_text=f"ELO = {y}",
        annotation_position="top right",
        annotation_xshift=-25,
    )

_ = fig.update_layout(
    autosize=True,
    showlegend=False,          
    xaxis=dict(tickangle=0),
    plot_bgcolor="white")

_ = fig.update_layout(modebar_remove=["toImage", "zoom", "pan", "select", "lasso", "autoScale"])



fig.show(config={"responsive": True, "displaylogo": False})
```
